mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_channel ( channel_id, channel_name, channel_type, webhook_url, secret, notify_severities, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{channelId}, #{channelName}, #{channelType}, #{webhookUrl}, #{secret}, #{notifySeverities}, #{status}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, channel_id, channel_name, channel_type, webhook_url, secret, notify_severities, status, create_time, update_time FROM notification_channel WHERE channel_id = #{channelId}
SELECT id, channel_id, channel_name, channel_type, webhook_url, secret, notify_severities, status, create_time, update_time FROM notification_channel WHERE status = 1
SELECT id, channel_id, channel_name, channel_type, webhook_url, secret, notify_severities, status, create_time, update_time FROM notification_channel ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_channel SET status = #{status}, update_time = now() WHERE channel_id = #{channelId}
